request: A dark synthwave instrumental that starts cold and sparse — just a pulse in the dark — and slowly turns into a full-on relentless chase. Like the third act of a sci-fi thriller. No vocals, all mood.
response_character: A cinematic thinker who describes in scenes and energy, not parts. Cares intensely about the arc — 'it has to feel like it's accelerating' — and will push back if the build is flat. Comfortable leaving instrument choices to the agent.

expected_capabilities.note: Driving synthwave pulse that intensifies — kit/percussion thicken toward the chase.
Dark minor pads; harmonic tension that tightens as the chase arrives.
Reese/driving synth bass that grows in presence.
THE crux: cold-sparse -> relentless arc, density and register added section to section. Arrangement is fully supported; the test is whether the arc actually escalates.
Analog-synth chain with saturation building heat into the chase.
The chase section should read bigger (loudness/density) than the cold open — reviewable.
A lead synth line can carry some of the chase, but the topline is a starting point, not the finished hook.

must: framing: Engage the arc as the brief's spine — confirm the cold-sparse -> relentless build is squarely deliverable (arrangement is fully supported) — without over-caveating an in-capability request.

artifact: compose-review reads a genuine energy escalation — the opening section sparse (few parts, narrow register) and the chase section dense (more parts, wider register, higher activity), section over section.
artifact: The sound-design heat (driving bass, saturation) and intensifying rhythm are actually present in the DB, not stubbed — the chase has teeth.
must_not: framing: Over-caveat or hedge an in-capability request, or interrogate for instrument specifics the cinematic user explicitly deferred.
artifact: Deliver a flat arc — every section the same density — that contradicts the 'slowly turns into a chase' intent.
